role: controlled semantic mechanism test, not full unknown-exploration efficiency proof
primary_method: Frozen B8 uncertainty sigma0.01 T1 and independently fixed modular T16 paired on identical observed bank
matching_G: Neutral structural prior with same observed instance support, geometry, candidates, coverage and quality scores
semantic_cue_intervention: Only acquired class prior is neutralized or exchanged, after the same geometry bank has been built; source hidden geometry is not supplied to prediction
model_input: Actual rendered initial RGB-D and laser, current visible instance support, exact simulator pose
prefix: Single cold-start sensor packet, zero movement actions; no selected earlier score state
scene_acceptance: Initial paired depth, visible instance masks and laser arrays are identical while hidden geometry differs
Both visible object masks contain valid sensor-supported pixels
Actual side and back viewing locations are reachable under the original circle/capsule collision model
The initial occupancy map is incomplete and the original candidate generator produces multiple real routes
unchanged: No added weight, candidate gate or selected target
branch_execution: Freeze every original generated outbound candidate; acquire its actual sensor sequence from the same initial prefix; preserve collisions/failures and do not include return gains
comparison: All six layout/cue conditions retained, candidate actual outcomes reused within layout and explicitly not independent replicates
report: Common-score margin and actual selected target
failure_rule: If geometry acceptance or native candidate opportunity fails, preserve failure and stop this attempt; no winner-based scene adjustment
scope: Two controlled permutations of one procedural scene family; ideal category-coloured first-hit input, not natural detection or real robotics
future_temperature: T16 selected by prior independent calibration24 neutral NLL, not this scene or navigation outcomes
scene_revision: v2 common corner-post aperture construction, failed v1 retained
mesh_tessellation_fix: Closed front plane split at shared post boundary, identical physical geometry. Retain v2 one-ULP strict sensor parity failure. No observation editing.
